summary: PM stage not re-run: this feature is already scoped P0 and GO'd under the FINTRACK-001 project-level business case (trace_id d58dcaced31a47a99e251654244d1dc9) as 'Weekly what-should-I-do-next recommendation + threshold-based alerts'. Reviewed the pre-existing 4-scenario Gherkin draft against Jira's ACs. AC2 names three distinct trigger types (budget overrun risk, new subscriptions, spending spikes) but only budget-overrun had standalone scenario coverage -- the other two only appeared bundled together in the multi-trigger scenario, never individually. Added 2 scenarios (subscription-only trigger, spending-spike-only trigger) to close that gap. 6 scenarios total in tests/features/FINTRACK-21-weekly-recommendation-engine.feature.
open_questions: Exact priority ordering across all three trigger types (budget overrun vs. new subscription vs. spending spike) when more than one qualifies in the same week -- the multi-trigger scenario assumes budget-overrun wins but AC2 doesn't state a ranking. Flagging for Tech Lead to pick a rule, not prescribing one here.

5 story points for a rules engine with 3 trigger types + priority resolution + neutral fallback + user-scoping may exceed the ~3-day-per-story guideline -- flagging as a size concern rather than unilaterally splitting an already-created Jira story.
